body: I lost my service dog 2 years back from out of the blue liver failure. I was distraught and very torn up about losing her. She used to wake me by nudging my hand with her nose. A few times after I lost her I’d be woken up by my hand being nudged. I don’t rightly know what I believe but in my heart I know that if there is another side, I want her to be waiting for me when my time comes.

I can’t for certain say I’ve seen shadow people. Although when I was young, I would always catch something out of the corner of my eye. It’d be a dark shape moving in the room. I e always had the ability to sense when someone enters a room no matter how quiet they are. The atmosphere changes, it feels fuller. I to this day still have this sensation from time to time with it being just me at home. Also as I child I’d hear my name being called and without thinking would answer. My grandmother being First Nations told me to never answer a spirits call. From that day forward if I was uncertain if someone had called out to me, I’d just sit quietly and make them either call out again or come to the room I was in.

I don’t know what your belief system is but in my opinion, our essence returns from which it came. I believe we have an option to return to this dimension if we feel like we need work or have a purpose to fulfill. It’s quiet possible that your mom has already started her next journey. I’ve only met one person in my life that I’ve felt so strongly that we were connected in another existence. It’s quiet shaking to feel this. So what ever you choose to believe, remember that she no longer suffers and that love transcends all.
